August 24, 2026
Biggest, Bloodiest Update to Hunt: Showdown 1896 is Almost Here
Hunters,
This September 8th we bring you a grim tale of
dark experiments, a story of monstrous hunger, and bloody, Corrupted promises
of power in Blood Testament. Our new in-game Event will be the biggest one this
year, and will bring with it Update 2.9 with good bloody content and many
exciting changes.
Take a look at the trailer for Blood Testament now:
YouTube player uses cookies.
You have to accept the cookie policy to watch the video.
Accept
A New Nightmare Is Rising
Desperate men make easy victims. Corruption can take
everything from a man, and one such Hunter named Warren Russett lost it all,
until Lynch came along and offered her newly formulated blood serum. Russett
became hopelessly addicted, gaining an insatiable thirst for blood to
tremendous and deadly consequences.
This is the story of Blood Testament, and it is up to
players to discover its twisted ending. With Update 2.9, Hunt: Showdown 1896
brings a massive Community Event—Make Them Bleed—in which all players will
participate by earning points earned through completing objectives in Missions and
unlocking major new changes to gameplay.
Community Event Points can be earned through a blood
sacrifice of killing monsters and Targets, as well as interacting with Blood
Wells.
Blood Wells have sprung up all over the bayou and the gulch.
You can find one per compound, and just like a Clue, each Blood Well can be
interacted with once by each team. Introducing a new layer of strategy to each
Bounty Hunt, Blood Wells grant Hunters a new Burn Trait called Siphon in
exchange for a small portion of their health.
Make Them Bleed's progression will be split into three
stages, each unlocking a new significant reward. Stage I will reward the whole
community with the new Time of Day Blood Moon, and Stage II will give a new
bloodthirsty Trait—Chupacabra. Stage III, however, will unleash the true new
nightmare on the bayou.
Bloody New Traits
Blood Testament will reward the players with unique,
game-changing new Traits:
Siphon Burn Trait: acquired by players
through interacting with Blood Wells. It allows the looting of a Scarce Trait
off an enemy Hunter's body, leaving the “Siphon" Trait in its place. Blood
Wells will be present in-game during Make Them Bleed through Stages I and II.
Chupacabra Burn Trait: allows players to
interact with animals in-game to restore 1 Health Chunk. Can be purchased for 2
Upgrade Points when unlocked.
The Blood Moon Above
Blood Testament brings a chilling atmosphere by introducing
a dynamic new Time of Day. The Blood Moon rises into the night, changing the
aesthetic of the maps while empowering the monstrous fauna of the Hunt. Blood
Moon adds a twist to the flow of PvP fights, with two phases for players to
encounter:
During the Intense Blood Moon, a crimson
light breaks through the stormy clouds, bathing the map in a stronger red glow
and driving monsters to attack more aggressively and quickly.
When the Dark Blood Moon occurs, dark
clouds cover the sky, reducing visibility and protecting the bayou and the
gulch from the influence of the red glow, returning monster behavior to normal.
Brutal Firepower
Hunt is well known for its intricate weapon designs, and
Blood Testament brings some exciting new additions to the game accordingly:
The Burgess is a foldable, slide-action
shotgun with a long barrel and a 6-round magazine. Its weapon capacity of Size
3 comes at the cost of long equip and unequip animations. It can be used with
the “Bulletgrubber" Trait to recover ejected live shells.
The Burgess Bayonet variant adds a blade
to the original weapon, at the cost of longer deployment time.
The Burgess Trauma variant features a
reinforced stock that changes the heavy melee attack into a hammer strike.
During Blood Testament, all Burgess variants are unlocked
via the Battle Pass and will stay unlocked through Prestige. The weapons will
be added to normal weapon progression after the conclusion of the Event.
Update 2.9
Blood Testament launches alongside Update 2.9, bringing
sweeping changes shaped by community feedback.
Combat sees significant shifts. The Hunting
Bow's one-hit kill range and reserve ammo have been reduced, while the Terminus
gains increased damage and tighter spread. Slug pricing drops across multiple
weapons, and the new LeMat High Velocity Ammo enters the arsenal.
Tool and Consumable prices have been adjusted, and the Heavy Knife swing melee
hit detection has been heightened to improve the chance of landing a hit.
Traits can now be saved as part of Loadouts
(0–15 per build, at a dual cost of Hunt Dollars and Upgrade Points), and the
number of potential Hunter Slots has expanded from 75 to 100.
The bayou grows more treacherous: all
Extraction Points, Supply Points, and Scout Towers are now hidden by default.
Interacting with a Clue reveals two Extraction Points, and Scouting Maps can
appear at any Supply Point. In addition, the Spyglass is still able to reveal
hidden compass icons.
Matchmaking and security have been overhauled. MMR
Decay now grants returning players a temporary modifier that reduces
matchup difficulty after a longer absence, gradually tapering off as they shake
off the rust.
The New Player Modifier follows the same
philosophy, replacing the old flat reduction that abruptly ended at a specific
Bloodline Rank with a smoother curve that gives newcomers a fairer fighting
chance against similarly skilled opponents.
On the security front, Fair Play Follow Up marks
the first step toward more complex reimbursements: players whose Hunters fell
to a confirmed cheater will now receive an automatic flat reimbursement in Hunt
Dollars, while those whose reports lead to action will receive a notification
of success. Both scenarios trigger a pop-up message on the first login after
the cheater is dealt with.
Be Prepared
Blood Testament will be a big addition to Hunt, and we look
forward to seeing the community come together to fight for a common goal.
Whether you are a seasoned veteran or just arriving to the bayou, it's a good
time to test yourself: will you join the fight against Corruption or take its
side? Let's see what the Blood Moon brings this September.
-
Your Hunt: Showdown 1896 Team
